blocks.body: A warm family story about the everyday ways parents care for their children — and the importance of extending that care to their financial future.

blocks.title: National Bank of Iraq Kids Account campaign film

blocks.body: Directed by Rafat Mhalla and Mohammad Jalal · 1 min 10 sec
Through a series of everyday family moments, the film connects the care parents provide today with the financial security they can create for tomorrow.
As Creative Director at Vision House, I worked alongside Mohammad Jalal to develop the campaign's emotional direction and shape its storytelling from concept through production.
